commonPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. A single original editorial painting for a contemporary Korean philosophy question, landscape 3:2 full bleed. Modern people, clothes, objects and settings; restrained classical figurative composition, natural anatomy, layered oil paint, soft chiaroscuro and visible subtle brush texture, readable at phone size. Depict the specified action concretely and neutrally, never imply a correct moral answer. No text, lettering, logos, signatures, watermark, collage, historical costumes, temples, mythology, generic pondering philosopher, decorative plants, fantasy robots or holograms. Scene:

assets.editPrompt: Edit the provided painting. Preserve its composition, contemporary home setting, lighting and oil-paint appearance. Correct the foreground woman's anatomy: she must have exactly TWO arms and TWO hands. Remove the extraneous middle hand and pen touching her chin entirely, showing a natural unobstructed chin and jacket instead. Keep her leftmost hand holding the folder and her rightmost hand holding the calendar. Do not add new hands, fingers, limbs, objects, or text.
